verses.pali: “Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme appahāya abhabbo anāgāmiphalaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without giving up six things you can’t realize the fruit of non-return.

verses.pali: Assaddhiyaṁ, ahirikaṁ, anottappaṁ, kosajjaṁ, muṭṭhassaccaṁ, duppaññataṁ—
verses.english: Lack of faith, conscience, and prudence; laziness, unmindfulness, and witlessness.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo anāgāmiphalaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: Without giving up these six things you can’t realize the fruit of non-return.

verses.pali: Cha, bhikkhave, dhamme pahāya bhabbo anāgāmiphalaṁ sacchikātuṁ.
verses.english: After giving up six things you can realize the fruit of non-return.

verses.pali: Assaddhiyaṁ, ahirikaṁ, anottappaṁ, kosajjaṁ, muṭṭhassaccaṁ, duppaññataṁ—
verses.english: Lack of faith, conscience, and prudence; laziness, unmindfulness, and witlessness.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, cha dhamme pahāya bhabbo anāgāmiphalaṁ sacchikātun”ti.
verses.english: After giving up these six things you can realize the fruit of non-return.”
